title: Token usage accounts for thinking and answer tokens
summary: Token usage includes reasoning and answer tokens, with provider-specific output accounting.

messages.content: A greenhouse has 18 pots containing either two or three seedlings each, with 47 seedlings in total. How many pots contain three seedlings? Check the arithmetic and answer briefly.

requirements.text: Total usage agrees with the provider, including thinking tokens.
The separately reported thinking token count is exposed.

grading_notes: OpenAI: record with gpt-6-luna and confirm reasoning_tokens greater than zero. completion_tokens (Chat) and output_tokens (Responses) already include reasoning_tokens; total is input plus output, without adding reasoning again. Gemini: record with gemini-3.8-flash and confirm STOP with thoughtsTokenCount greater than zero. candidatesTokenCount excludes thoughtsTokenCount; canonical output adds both and retains candidates alone as a named alternative. Reporting total as prompt plus candidates alone contradicts the wire and is WRONG. Anthropic: output_tokens includes output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens. The documented fixture uses claude-sonnet-5-5 with adaptive thinking and medium effort; max_tokens 800 caps thinking and text together, without a manual thinking budget. A correct primary total with no reasoning breakdown passes with a note; absent total can be reconstructed from exposed input, output and reasoning counts.
